title: 1RB0LE_0RC0RA_1RD1RF_1LA0LD_1LD0RF_1RB---: every copy round follows from a rule
text: Of the 7 turns at X that no rule covered, 4 are rounds over the front 1|e, whose middle reads the next block too; one more base shape covers them. The other 3, over the front 3|0 inside a copy of Y, are no rounds: there the head takes the pairs of X one by one, a loop already proved whole. So all 2,091 copy rounds of the run follow from rules for every front of their shape.
